module_scope: MM (Materials Management) — Purchasing (MM-PUR) and Inventory Management (MM-IM)
verification_note: confidence field indicates how sure this entry's identifier and behaviour are. 'high' = well-established, safe to demo. 'medium' = verify name/scope against your system before demo. 'low' = placeholder shape, must be replaced with a verified entry.

tiers.standard: SAP already does this. Build nothing.
tiers.configuration: Switch on or set up via IMG / Fiori config apps. No code.
tiers.key_user: Business user extends via Custom Fields and Logic. No developer.
tiers.developer_in_app: ABAP developer extension inside S/4HANA using released objects.
tiers.side_by_side: Separate app on BTP consuming released APIs.
tiers.modification: Change to SAP standard. Not permitted under clean core.

entries.name: Purchase order OData service
entries.capability: Read, create, update and delete purchase orders and items from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Purchase requisition OData service
entries.capability: Read, create and update purchase requisitions from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Material stock OData service
entries.capability: Read current stock quantities by material, plant and storage location from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Material document OData service
entries.capability: Read and post goods movements from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Product master OData service
entries.capability: Read, create and update material master data from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Business partner OData service
entries.capability: Read and maintain business partner and supplier data, including addresses and contact details.

entries.name: Supplier invoice OData service
entries.capability: Create and read supplier invoices from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Inbound delivery OData service
entries.capability: Read and update inbound deliveries from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Purchase contract OData service
entries.capability: Read and maintain purchase contracts from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Scheduling agreement OData service
entries.capability: Read and maintain scheduling agreements from outside S/4HANA.

entries.name: Product (CDS view)
entries.capability: Released read access to material master header data for in-app development and analytics.

entries.name: Product plant (CDS view)
entries.capability: Released read access to plant-level material data such as MRP and purchasing settings.

entries.name: Purchase order (CDS view)
entries.capability: Released read access to purchase order header data.

entries.name: Purchase order item (CDS view)
entries.capability: Released read access to purchase order item data including quantities, delivery dates and plant.

entries.name: Purchase requisition (CDS view)
entries.capability: Released read access to purchase requisition data.

entries.name: Material document item (CDS view)
entries.capability: Released read access to goods movement line items. Replaces direct reads of MSEG.

entries.name: Supplier (CDS view)
entries.capability: Released read access to supplier master data via the business partner model.

entries.name: Material stock (CDS view)
entries.capability: Released read access to current stock by material, plant and storage location.

entries.name: Purchase order processing BAdI
entries.capability: Intervene during purchase order creation and change. Validate fields, set defaults, raise errors, populate custom fields.

entries.name: Purchase requisition processing BAdI
entries.capability: Intervene during purchase requisition creation and change. Validate, default and enrich fields.

entries.name: Purchasing document posted BAdI
entries.capability: Trigger follow-on logic after a purchasing document is saved. Suitable for outbound notification or integration triggers.

entries.name: Requisition posted BAdI
entries.capability: Trigger follow-on logic after a purchase requisition is saved.

entries.name: MIGO goods movement BAdI
entries.capability: Intervene in the MIGO goods movement transaction. Add screen tabs, validate and enrich movement data.

entries.name: Material document BAdI
entries.capability: React to material document posting for follow-on logic.

entries.name: Purchase order GUI extension BAdI
entries.capability: Add custom screens and fields to the ME21N/ME22N/ME23N purchase order user interface.

entries.name: Hold purchase order BAdI
entries.capability: Control whether a purchase order may be held or parked.

entries.name: MRP list BAdI
entries.capability: Adjust MRP list output and element display.

entries.name: Custom field on purchase order
entries.capability: Add a custom field to purchase order header or item using the Custom Fields app, with optional exposure to UI, reports and APIs.
entries.source: Custom Fields and Logic app, business context Purchase Order

entries.name: Custom field on purchase requisition
entries.capability: Add a custom field to purchase requisition header or item using the Custom Fields app.
entries.source: Custom Fields and Logic app, business context Purchase Requisition

entries.name: Custom field on product master
entries.capability: Add a custom field to the material master using the Custom Fields app.
entries.source: Custom Fields and Logic app, business context Product

entries.name: Custom logic on purchase order
entries.capability: Add restricted ABAP logic at released enhancement points on the purchase order via the Custom Logic app. No screen changes, no external calls.
entries.source: Custom Fields and Logic app, Custom Logic tab

entries.name: Flexible workflow for purchase requisition approval
entries.capability: Multi-step approval of purchase requisitions with conditions on value, plant, material group and cost centre. Configured in the Manage Workflows app. No code.

entries.name: Flexible workflow for purchase order approval
entries.capability: Multi-step approval of purchase orders with condition-based routing. Configured in the Manage Workflows app. Replaces classic release strategies for many scenarios.

entries.name: Classic release strategy
entries.capability: Characteristic and class based release procedure for purchasing documents. Configured in IMG. No code.

entries.name: Output management for purchase orders
entries.capability: BRF+ based determination and issue of purchase order output by email, print or EDI, with form templates. Configured, not coded.

entries.name: Situation handling
entries.capability: Configurable detection of business situations such as overdue confirmations, with notification to a responsible user in the Fiori launchpad. Configured in the Manage Situation Types app.

entries.name: MRP Live
entries.capability: HANA-optimised material requirements planning run. Replaces classic MRP transaction MD01.

entries.name: Supplier evaluation
entries.capability: Scoring of suppliers on delivery, quality, price and service criteria with standard Fiori analytics.

entries.name: Batch management
entries.capability: Batch numbering, classification, determination and expiry handling. Configured in IMG.

entries.name: Physical inventory
entries.capability: Cycle counting and physical inventory documents with count entry, difference posting and analysis.

entries.name: Material number field length extension
entries.capability: Material number extended from 18 to 40 characters. Custom code with hardcoded 18-character assumptions must be adjusted.

entries.name: MM-IM data model change to MATDOC
entries.capability: MKPF and MSEG replaced by MATDOC. Aggregate stock tables such as MARD and MCHB are now views. Direct writes are not permitted and direct reads should move to released CDS views.

entries.name: Business partner mandatory for supplier
entries.capability: Supplier master is maintained through the business partner. Direct LFA1 reads and classic vendor transactions are affected.

entries.name: Classic MB goods movement transactions removed
entries.capability: Transactions such as MB01, MB11, MB1A, MB1B, MB1C and MB31 are no longer available. Goods movements go through MIGO or the released API.

entries.name: Foreign trade functionality in MM removed
entries.capability: Foreign trade fields and processing in MM are replaced by SAP Global Trade Services.

entries.name: Material ledger mandatory
entries.capability: Material ledger is active by default in S/4HANA. Custom valuation logic built on classic tables is affected.
